# Ankita Roy

## Market Research | Business Analytics | Consumer Insights

Market research and analytics professional with 4+ years of experience in market sizing, forecasting, competitive intelligence, and consumer insights across retail and consumer sectors.

## About Me

My background combines market research, economics, and data analytics. Before graduate school, I worked in the retail and consumer sectors, conducting market research, developing forecasts, analyzing competitive dynamics, and translating complex information into decision-ready business insights.

Today, I am expanding that foundation through graduate study and hands-on projects involving business analytics, data visualization, machine learning, natural language processing, and cloud analytics.
